name: Arrays
description: Contiguous memory structures, Kadane's algorithm, prefix sums, and in-place transformations.

name: Strings and Hashing
description: Frequency maps, hash sets, string manipulation, and palindrome checks.

name: Two Pointers
description: Opposite-end convergence, fast/slow runners, and sorted array searches.

name: Sliding Window
description: Variable and fixed size subarrays/substrings, dynamic expansion and shrink criteria.

name: Binary Search
description: Logarithmic search on sorted arrays, search space pruning, and rotated arrays.

name: Recursion
description: Base cases, recursive call stack, divide-and-conquer strategies.

name: Backtracking
description: Decision trees, prune invalid paths, state restoration, subsets and permutations.

name: Linked Lists
description: Singly and doubly linked lists, pointer manipulation, cycle detection.

name: Stacks and Queues
description: LIFO/FIFO orders, monotonic stacks, parenthesis matching, priority queues.

name: Trees
description: Binary trees, BST properties, DFS/BFS traversals, LCA, depth calculations.

name: Graphs
description: Adjacency lists/matrices, BFS, DFS, cycle detection, connected components.

name: Dynamic Programming
description: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization, 1D/2D tabulation.
